text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув just misses out on winning
the race,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You were great, Эйр Грув! Better luck
next
time!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
You're still the new queen in our hearts,
Air
Groove! You'll do better in the next
one!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
(It's a frustrating result, but my fans
accept my
performance anyway...)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув is still so dignified!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could stand so proud after a

disappointment?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
(As ever, people are always watching.
Perhaps
even more so after such a
disappointing loss. I
have to remember
that.)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: (Which means I can't afford to be upset!)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I apologize for failing to deliver a
satisfactory
result.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
This isn't the fault of your training. This
is due to
my own inadequacy. For that
reason—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Let's do even better in the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.text: Yes. That was always my intent.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You really are ever the optimist. I should
take a
page out of your book.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Let's go. The final race of the Triple
Tiara awaits.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
With her eyes on the final challenge, Air
Groove
ignites a new fire of motivation
in her heart!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
